status: The project brief instructed "record the five defined events" without enumerating them. This set is the build’s documented reading of that instruction and is flagged as an assumption at F-21.

events.name: page_view
events.what: A page on this origin finished loading.
events.why: Denominator for every other rate. Without it, a click count means nothing.

events.name: disclosure_view
events.what: The disclosure strip under the masthead entered the viewport.
events.why: Tests the compliance claim rather than assuming it. If this never fires on a page, the disclosure is not actually being seen.

events.name: outbound_click
events.what: A click on any link leaving this origin.
events.why: The brief’s privacy-preserving outbound-click counter. Captures where attention actually leaves.

events.name: affiliate_click
events.what: An outbound click whose destination host is amazon.com, www.amazon.com or link.amazon.
events.why: Separates product intent from citation clicks. A click on a source link is not a commercial signal and must not be counted as one.

events.name: reader_capture
events.what: A submission of the reader-capture form to a configured endpoint.
events.why: SG-30. Only fires when an endpoint exists, so it can never over-report a capture that was silently dropped.

neverRecorded: full destination URL of an outbound click
scroll depth, dwell time or reading position
privacy.storage: Five integers under one localStorage key on this origin. Aggregate counts only.

collector.reasonNotDeployed: GitHub Pages serves static files and executes nothing server-side. See flag F-11.
